1.title: Fire Near Reno, Nev., Prompts Evacuations of Homes and Hospitals
1.summary: The Hawk fire has burned over 10,000 acres and is encroaching on the northern part of the city. Residents of 14,000 homes have been told to flee, and the governor issued a state of emergency.

2.title: Trump waves green flag kicking off high-speed IndyCar race through Washington
2.summary: The president took a ceremonial lap of the track before the race, which is the culmination of a summer of events to mark the country's 250th birthday.

3.title: Thousands struggling without power in Indiana 12 days after severe storms
3.summary: In the town of Gary, where a third of residents live in poverty, people say they have been living in "survival mode".
